candidate2_correction.F01: Each fresh fixture creates a second unique NOLOGIN beta owner. Only that new role receives a global default-function PUBLIC EXECUTE revocation. Installation creates the three entrypoints under SET LOCAL ROLE beta owner; schema, eight tables and entrypoints are beta-owner owned. The two cross-boundary helpers remain operator-owned, PUBLIC/runtime/other-role denied and executable only by the beta owner. The identity helper derives auth.uid internally, so the beta owner has no auth or neuvetra schema/table/sequence/function privileges. Readiness and install replay verify exact role flags and memberships in both directions, owner identities, default ACL, five-function split and grants.
candidate2_correction.F02: The production-intended local adapter uses node:http under Bun, streams requests without buffering, and explicitly ends the underlying socket after a decorated 413. At the 2048-byte application boundary, cancellation permits at most 6144 residual bytes for at most 50ms while the response closes; it never waits for an unbounded drain. Incoming premature close errors and settles the request stream; output or socket close settles backpressure and cancels the response body. The old Bun.serve boundary is no longer used by the canonical rehearsal. Imports remain inert.
